picks.question: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the September 2026 meeting?
picks.why: A September hike would mark a policy turn, resetting borrowing costs and asset valuations.

picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: Priced odds of 4.5% inflation show the tail risk that would upend rate expectations.

picks.question: Will China’s 2026 annual GDP growth (Y/Y) be between 4.0% and 5.0%?
picks.why: Whether China lands near its growth target anchors global demand, commodity prices and trade forecasts.

picks.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Frontier model leadership shapes AI capital spending, chip demand and competition across the sector.

picks.question: OpenAI announces it has achieved AGI before 2027?
picks.why: A declared AGI milestone would shift expectations for labor markets, investment and regulation.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state wealth tax would test long-debated questions about capital mobility and revenue yield.
